acme_ops: Hi team — after our OIDC migration this morning a bunch of analysts can't access Project Apollo in the console. They click the project and get a 403 page. API calls using existing service tokens that used to work now return:

acme_ops: ```json
{"status":403,"error":"permission_denied","message":"User lacks project.viewer role on project:apollo"}
```

acme_ops: Repro steps I tried:
1) Login via SSO (Okta OIDC)
2) Click Projects -> Apollo
3) Console shows 403 UI
4) `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/projects/apollo` -> 403 as above

jessica (Support): Thanks — can you confirm the affected users are SSO accounts and not local invite accounts? Also, any group membership changes in Okta during the cutover?

acme_ops: All SSO users. We imported groups and switched from SCIM push to SCIM_SCIM_RELAY (we had to re-map group names). No manual role changes on Redwood side.

alex (SRE): Quick checklist: 1) Are there org-level deny policies? 2) Did role sync jobs run? 3) Any errors in the identity sync logs?

acme_ops: We didn't touch any deny policies. Role sync shows 'completed' in the Admin > Identity page but times look like they finished before mapping change.

priya (Identity): I'm pulling the idp-sync logs now. @idp-bot can you paste the last 50 lines for org acme-corp sync job?

idp-bot: ```
[2026-03-12T09:02:11Z] INFO starting sync for org acme-corp
[2026-03-12T09:02:12Z] WARN group mapping mismatch: okta-group "analysts_team" -> no role mapping found
[2026-03-12T09:02:12Z] ERROR skipped role assignment for user jane.doe because group mapping missing
[2026-03-12T09:02:12Z] INFO sync completed with warnings (2 skipped)
```

priya (Identity): Looks like group name changed in Okta during migration and the mapping file on Redwood still references the old group id. That explains 2 skipped assignments (including jane.doe).

jessica (Support): Could that produce a 403 on console and for service tokens too?

alex (SRE): If the service tokens were tied to a user account that lost its project.role assignment, yes. Also check whether tokens were minted as scoped to project.apollo — if the principal's role mapping disappeared tokens still valid at the token-level but authorization will fail.

acme_ops: That sounds right — the affected token belongs to a long-lived service user (svc-analytics) that was bound to the 'analysts_team' Okta group.

priya (Identity): Workaround: I can temporarily map the current Okta group name back to the analysts role in the identity mapping UI. That should restore access immediately. I'll also trigger a full re-provisioning sync (`POST /admin/internal/identity/sync?org=acme-corp`).

priya (Identity): Done — mapped okta-group "analysts_team_v2" -> role project:apollo.viewer. Triggered sync at 09:15 UTC.

idp-bot: ```
[2026-03-12T09:15:05Z] INFO starting sync for org acme-corp
[2026-03-12T09:15:22Z] INFO assigned role project:apollo.viewer to user svc-analytics
[2026-03-12T09:15:22Z] INFO assigned role project:apollo.viewer to user jane.doe
[2026-03-12T09:15:22Z] INFO sync completed
```

acme_ops: Confirmed! svc-analytics calls now return 200 and the console loads for our analysts. Thanks.

jessica (Support): Glad that's fixed. We'll keep this thread open until you validate everything for the rest of your users.

alex (SRE): Follow-ups for internal: 1) add a migration check that alerts when group names change during SCIM/OKTA cutovers, 2) log clearer 'skipped' reasons on the admin UI, 3) provide a CLI helper to re-map groups to roles quickly.

priya (Identity): I'll create a ticket to add an importer that tries fuzzy matches between old and new group names before skipping.

acme_ops: Appreciate it. One more ask — can Redwood push a notification to admins when role assignments are skipped during sync? We would have been able to react faster.

jessica (Support): Noted — I'll file a product request and mark it P2. For now, if you see `WARN group mapping mismatch` in idp logs, that's the key signal. We'll also email org admins when sync completes with warnings.

deploy-bot: auto-deploy:identity-mappings v1.4.2 -> prod at 2026-03-13T02:10:00Z :rocket:

acme_ops: Thanks everyone. Closing after full org check.

jessica (Support): Closing on our side — please reopen if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
